context: Whole group celebrates Kenji and Aoi's wedding anniversary.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: けんちゃん、結婚、何年やね、もう!
lines.en: Ken-chan, how many years has it been now?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate wonder. Soft attack. Her voice carries years of watching him grow. A little breathless on the question, like time has moved faster than expected. Genuine delight underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ほんま、長年、お互い尽くしてきたな。
lines.en: You're right — all these years we've been there for each other.
lines.style: Steady, grateful. Kansai warmth without loudness. He settles into the words. A light emphasis on 'long years' — not rushing. The kind of simple honesty that takes a lifetime to earn.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 深く愛情、感じる夫婦ね。
lines.en: You can really feel the depth of love between them.
lines.style: Soft, admiring observation. Tender but not sentimental. She speaks almost to herself, noticing something true. Warm on 'deeply' — a gentle recognition. No performance, just sincerity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おめでとうございます!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered joy. No hesitation. The energy of a six-year-old who's just learned something wonderful and needs to say it immediately. Open vowels, genuine delight.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Moments like this warm your heart.
lines.style: Soft, contented wonder. Eight-year-old sweetness — she's feeling something big and speaking it simply. Warm on 'warm' — a little dreamy. The voice of someone taking the moment in.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 感謝、ようけ、伝えたいわ。
lines.en: There's so much gratitude I want to express.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly — she's moved. Kansai softness with real emotion underneath. She slows on 'gratitude,' letting the weight of it land. A breath before finishing. Composed but genuinely touched.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 皆のおかげで、ここまで来れた。
lines.en: I wouldn't have come this far without all of you.
lines.style: Humble, genuinely meant. Aoi speaks from the chest — not performing humility but feeling it. Warm on 'all of you.' A slight pause before she finishes, like she's looking at each person as she says it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これからも、幸せに、過ごそうな!
lines.en: Let's keep making happy memories together from here on.
lines.style: Warm, Kansai-tinged commitment. He speaks with quiet conviction — not loud, but settled. A light lift on 'from here on' — looking forward. Generous with the promise he's making.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私たちも、応援、ずっとよ。
lines.en: We'll always be cheering you both on.
lines.style: Steady, tender assurance. Mei speaks like a promise. Slow, warm pace. She leans into 'always' — not rushed. The voice of someone who means what she says and will remember it later.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure brightness, no filter. Six-year-old wonder at something big and joyful. Quick energy, open delivery. His excitement is simple and complete — this is the best day.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: A day like this is a real treasure.
lines.style: Eight-year-old reverence. Hina speaks softly, like she's protecting something precious. Warm on 'treasure' — she knows this moment matters. A slight trailing-off, holding the feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おばあちゃんも、嬉しい!
lines.style: Warm, tender acknowledgement. Yumiko's voice carries years of watching families celebrate. A light lift on her happiness — genuine, simple. The contentment of a mother seeing everyone she loves gathered and at peace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Animated Kansai warmth, building energy. Kenji lifts his voice on this — brighter, more expansive than before. Open, generous delivery. The voice of someone gathering everyone around something good.
